name: Securo
short_desc: Open-source personal finance manager, self-hosted and privacy-first
author: securo-finance
description: Securo is a self-hosted personal finance manager. Track accounts with running balances, import transactions from OFX, QIF, CAMT and CSV files, auto-categorise them with a rules engine, and follow budgets, recurring transactions, goals and assets over time. Net worth and income-versus-expenses reports come built in, with multi-currency support and automatic FX conversion. Bank sync is optional and provider-based: Enable Banking for roughly 2500 European PSD2 banks, SimpleFIN for US and international banks, Pluggy for Brazilian banks. Multi-user with an admin panel, TOTP two-factor, passkeys and OIDC login, plus an optional self-hosted AI agents feature that can chat over your own data.

form_fields.label: Trusted proxy hops
form_fields.hint: Reverse-proxy hops in front of the API, used to key rate limiting by real client IP. Use 1 when you reach Securo on the host IP and port, 2 when you expose it through Runtipi with a domain.

form_fields.label: Open Exchange Rates app ID
form_fields.hint: Optional free key from openexchangerates.org. Without it, cross-currency amounts fall back to a 1:1 rate with a warning.

form_fields.label: Enable SimpleFIN bank sync?
form_fields.hint: Read-only bank sync for US and international banks. Each connection brings its own setup token from bridge.simplefin.org, so there is nothing else to configure.

form_fields.label: Enable Banking application ID
form_fields.hint: Optional PSD2 bank sync for European banks. Also put the application's PEM key at <app data>/secrets/enable_banking_private.pem.

form_fields.label: Enable AI agents?
form_fields.hint: Self-hosted LLM chat over your finance data. Add a provider connection under Settings after enabling.
